products.name: Color Wow Dream Coat for Curls
products.ingredients_raw: water aqua eau, vp va copolymer, propylene glycol, hydroxyethylcellulose, glycerin, oleth-20, polyquaternium-10, citric acid, dmdm hydantoin
products.description: This is not even remotely the same as the non-curly version which is a serum. This is more a light-hold gel. I think this is a good option for easily weighed down hair like fine curls but it's not enough hold for wavy hair.
